name: fx
summary: Warmth -> Reverb -> Echo effect chain

name: pitch_shift
summary: Shift pitch by semitones (WSOLA or formant engine)

name: mastering
summary: Multiband compression + dynamic EQ mastering

name: normalize
summary: Peak normalize, gain capped by the absolute peak

name: trim
summary: Silence the selected window (duration unchanged)

name: join
summary: Cut the selected window out and join the remainder

name: dc_remove
summary: Remove DC offset (subtract the mean)

name: fade_ends
summary: Short linear fades at both ends

name: silence_trim
summary: Trim leading/trailing silence below a threshold

name: hum_notch
summary: Notch out mains hum at the given frequency

name: declip
summary: Reconstruct clipped (flat-topped) samples

name: denoise
summary: Spectral-gating noise reduction

name: deplosive
summary: Reduce plosive low-frequency bursts

name: deess
summary: Reduce sibilance (de-esser)

name: level
summary: Level volume over time (slow gain riding)

name: loudness
summary: Normalize integrated loudness to a LUFS target

name: eq_balance
summary: Low/high shelf EQ balance

name: tune_up
summary: Composite op: expand and apply a list of fix sub-ops

name: punch_in
summary: Splice a recorded take into the track at a frame offset

name: livefx
summary: Display-only label for live-FX takes (never re-rendered)
